1.source: Rewritten 2026-11-21 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase), following the KJV's Greek text (Textus Receptus, checked against Moorman's 8,000 Differences), at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses.

verses.text: The elder to the wellbeloved (dearly loved) Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
Beloved (dear friend), I wish above all things that you may prosper (do well) and be in health, even as your soul prospers (does well).
For I rejoiced greatly when the brothers came and testified (told) of the truth that is in you, even as you walk in the truth.
I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
Beloved (dear friend), you do faithfully whatever you do for the brothers, and for strangers.
They have borne witness of your charity (love) before the church. If you bring them forward on their journey in a godly way, you will do well.
Because for His name's sake they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles (people who are not Jews).
So we ought to receive such people, so that we might be fellowhelpers (helpers together) to the truth.
I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes, who loves to have the preeminence (first place) among them, does not receive us.

So if I come, I will remember the deeds Diotrephes does, prating (talking nonsense) against us with malicious (hateful) words. And not content with that, Diotrephes himself does not receive the brothers. He forbids those who want to, and casts them out of the church.
Beloved (dear friend), do not follow what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God. But the one who does evil has not seen God.
Demetrius has good report from all men, and from the truth itself. Yes, and we also bear record (witness), and you know that our record (witness) is true.
I had many things to write, but I will not write to you with ink and pen.
But I trust I will see you shortly, and we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. Our friends salute (greet) you. Greet the friends by name.
